name: primitives-texts-typing
blurb: Text appears character-by-character as if being typed.
description: Animates text as a typewriter effect, revealing characters sequentially with optional cursor animation.
use_when: Narratives, code snippets, or onboarding text.
avoid_when: Body content — typing delay makes the text unavailable until animation completes.
a11y: Content is hidden until typed. Screen readers may announce before visible.
